introduced.where: Section 1.3, Context (reported from the source), second paragraph
introduced.quote: So the failure itself is an imported fact, not a result of the present paper.
introduced.problem: This misdescribes what the source proves. The source's Theorem 1 is exactly the failure of the proposed bound in dimension twenty, proved self-containedly; the rewrite itself says two sentences later that the theorem is "proved below without using any cited result". The source only says the cited Feng–Hu–Liu–Xu result "already gives a negative answer", i.e. the failure is not new. It does not say the failure is imported or not a result of the paper. No proof step depends on this sentence, so the mathematics is unaffected.
